item.title: Add custom OpenAI endpoint configuration (Base URL & Model Parameter) of copilot chat settings

Feature Request: Custom OpenAI Endpoint Configuration (Base URL & Model Parameter)


With the recent update in Copilot Chat v1.99 allowing users to bring their own API keys for providers such as Azure, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI, Ollama, and Open Router, it would be beneficial to extend this flexibility further by enabling a custom configuration for OpenAI. This feature would allow users to specify a custom base URL and model parameter directly in the Copilot Chat interface.

Feature Details:

Custom Base URL:
Allow users to provide a custom base URL for the OpenAI API. This is especially helpful for users who may be working with self-hosted instances or region-specific endpoints.

Custom Model Parameter:
Add an option to specify a preferred model parameter. This would enable users to configure and test various models (including newly released or experimental ones) without waiting for native support.

This feature will make Cursor and Windsurf useless.

comments.body: A quick note to tack on, a great addition to this feature would be allowing multiple OpenAI (compatible) endpoints. I use multiple custom endpoints but would also like to be able to still use OpenAI themselves.

Can OpenAI-compatible providers be added as well?
I want to use copilot with [LiteLLM](https://www.litellm.ai/) proxy.
This is the final step for BYOK. I want to use my OpenAI compatible provider venice.ai

This will allow us to use docker model runner as a provider. With its native performance in contrast to classic containerized LLMs and support in docker compose this will make cool and portable setup for offline LLM assisted coding.

This is an excellent suggestion. In private enterprises, it is typically not possible to access all cloud provider models directly. Access must go through an internally deployed proxy to comply with audit procedures. Allowing customization of the Base URL and Model Name would better accommodate the needs of most users.

Thanks.
the rate limits sucks

> Can OpenAI-compatible providers be added as well? I want to use copilot with [LiteLLM](https://www.litellm.ai/) proxy. 

Agree, with litellm I have a single endpoint that wraps all my provider (sonnet, openai, azure openai, ollama etc). This is super useful for all that software, like open-webui that rely on OpenAI for API schema. In such a scenario a model is exposed with an url like this

```
http://localhost:4000/openai/deployments/o3/chat/completions
```

That answer with the same schema of openai so it is super easy for copilot to just support a URL+KEY and then assume that its OpenAI. 

Since litellm can be installed in docker with a simple docker file it is really useful to have it supported.

This would be very helpful, especially if the implementation allows configuration of a custom base URL for Anthropic models as well. For inspiration, please consider referring to Continue.dev's configurability: https://docs.continue.dev/reference#models

Hi everyone ! Just wondering — _is there any update on this essential feature?_
Many of us are really looking forward to using custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints (like LiteLLM or self-hosted setups) directly with Copilot. It would unlock so much flexibility for enterprise and offline use cases.
